title: Jovial Golden Portuguese Cheese Lasagna
description: A cozy Portuguese dish featuring cumin seeds and a blend of cheeses, perfect for a cold winter night. This recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and has a nice cheese-pull.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cumin seeds, mustard, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a large baking dish, create a thin layer of the cheese mixture and arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Sprinkle the parmesan cheese over the top layer of cheese.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
